title: Maximize Distance
prompt: Solve the programming problem in problem.md (examples in examples.json). Write the complete Python 3 solution to `solution.py` in this directory. `solution.py` reads the input from standard input and writes the answer to standard output. Hidden tests check correctness and speed (CPython 3.14, about 6 s per test, standard library only). There is no internet access. Only `solution.py` is graded.
